$comment: Who may read and write each model of prisma/schema/roles.prisma (rules: src/ownership.ts; roles: src/roles.ts). Only office sessions and the worker touch them, as factory_runtime inside their own tenant: the office authenticator reads the person's live assignments and their roles on every request to build the session's grants, and the roles routes (apps/factory-api platform/auth/roles) write them through command(). The floor role reads Role (its floor sessions' grants come from the worker's live floor roles, floor-auth.json WorkerRole, read in the device's site scope; a role is tenant-wide, it has no site); it reads no RoleAssignment (office people's assignments). The partner role gets no access here: the links step gives link sessions fixed grants. No role deletes: an assignment is ended (endedAt), a role is kept for the history. After a change run `npm run policies -w @nexus/factory-db -- <folder>`.

Role.about: The tenant's system roles (synced from the factory-domain templates) and custom roles: read by the authenticator and the role screens, written by the roles routes. The floor authenticator reads the worker's floor roles.

RoleAssignment.about: Who holds which role, over which companies, sites and parties, from when to when: read by the authenticator on every request, written by the roles routes and invitations, ended (never deleted).
